text_block_list.text:
Invited by Reporter Otonashi, Taiki 
Shuttle came along to watch the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

The highlight of the race was the clash 
between the "Umamusume of the Year," Air 
Groove, and the race favorite, Silence 
Suzuka...

Claiming victory in that match with a 
breathtaking front-runner performance was 
Silence Suzuka! Once again, she delivered 
a race that would remain forever in 
everyone's hearts.
